answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded escrows that make coordinated equivocation costly: when k identities are linked to the same conflicting attestations, penalties scale as O(k²), rather than as independent minor fines. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation, so a controlled swarm faces an exponential multiplier in total capital loss. Juniper, velvet, and tundra labels do not hide shared control or reduce correlated penalties.
